title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：rock　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rock 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the farmer ① climbed the rock that no child in the field would have described, and he said the climbing was the whole of the autumn. The ② rock, meaning the stone itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a rock, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ rock in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ rock at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rock, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the farmer said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rock was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the stone. The ⑥ rock, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; rock, he said, is either something you climb or the only word that means both a stone and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ rock had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ rock of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of describing; rock, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rock I remember is the stone described in the almanac, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ rock, my mother said in 1974, is the only stone that improves by being described; every rock, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a stone. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 岩石；摇滚乐（指田垄里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 岩石；摇滚乐（指那块岩石本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：climb the rock 攀这一块岩石
D. n. 岩石；摇滚乐（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 岩石之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的岩石之事）
F. n. 岩石；摇滚乐（指农事历里写到、被描述的那一块）
G. n. 岩石、坚毅（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 坚毅（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: climbed the rock that no child in the field would have described
The rock, meaning the stone itself and not the basket
the rock at the far fence
the rock was the whole of the matter
the rock had become a line in an almanac
The rock of the whole thing
A rock, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: climb the rock 意为“攀这一块岩石”，1965 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯描述的一块岩石做了一遍。
rock 意为“岩石；摇滚乐”，指那块岩石本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
rock 意为“岩石；摇滚乐”，指田垄里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
rock 意为“岩石；摇滚乐”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rock 意为“岩石、坚毅”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块坚毅就是那件事的全部。
rock 意为“坚毅”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块岩石，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rock 意为“岩石；摇滚乐”，指农事历里写到、被描述的那一块，到 1970 年这一块成了农事历里的一行。
rock 意为“岩石之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的岩石之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的描述。
rock 意为“岩石；摇滚乐”，我记得的是农事历里描述过的那一块，1972 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一块。
rock 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，岩石是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的岩石。
